primary_documentation.paraphrase: Nonprivate Mach-O symbols receive an underscore prefix. Applied to the declared C global, that yields the double-underscore spelling.

Default BSD output puts hexadecimal address, type and symbol name on each line. The unchanged -gU request selects external defined symbols. This candidate reads already inspected native Mach-O libraries, not LLVM bitcode.
